title: Reserved type 127 in valid 104 envelope
purpose: Exercise reserved-type dispatch near the documented type-id boundary while keeping framing and field widths valid and minimal.
expected_behavior: The receiver should accept the APDU envelope and route type_id 127 to reserved or unknown-type handling without frame desynchronization.
constraints_preserved: Type_id 127 is within the documented 1..127 parse range and explicitly listed as reserved
APDU length 0x0e matches the 14 bytes following the length byte
Cause of transmission 5 request is encoded using two octets
Common address is two octets and information object address is three octets
No undocumented object payload is appended
issue_safety_notes: Uses a structurally valid boundary-adjacent reserved type instead of malformed length or truncation patterns.
